title: Region categories
description: Folders the admin page's Regions tab sorts regions into. A category lists the ids of its regions; a region is in at most one category, and regions in none show under "Uncategorized". The order of this list is the order of the folders. Edited from the admin page; the public embed doesn't use it.

id.description: Permanent identifier (a slug made from the name when the category was created).

name.description: What the folder is called; can be renamed.

parent.description: The id of the folder this one sits in. Absent at the top level.

createdBy.description: Who created the category. Without it, the category belongs to the repository owner.

regions.description: Ids of the regions in this category (file names in content/regions/ without .json).
